newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ascend started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ascend started as buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage of Ascend Communications Inc with a buy rating and set a 12-month price target of $80 a share.
-- expects continued positive revenue and earnings growth driven by expanding remote access market.
-- expects revenue growth of 70 percent for calendar 1997 and 46 percent for calendar 1998. Sees earnings growth of 52 percent for calendar 1997 and 35 percent for 1998.
-- sees continued market share gains driven by new product introductions.
